summary: On February 23, 2026, an unknown external actor gained unauthorized access to City of Port Hueneme, California files. The city learned of it on March 3, 2026 when the actor contacted city employees and a city councilmember claiming to have accessed city files. An independent investigation confirmed data was acquired without authorization, and on April 24, 2026 the city determined that personal information including names and other data elements was affected. The city notified affected individuals, law enforcement and the FBI and offered 12 months of CyberScout credit monitoring.
